description: The Solomon Islands National Statistics Office publishes the 2019 Population and Housing Census national report, volumes one and two, as a single PDF of 305 pages. Chapter fourteen covers households and housing with tables by province and by urban or rural area: housing and land tenure, dwelling type, the main material of walls, floors and roofs, rooms per dwelling, drinking water sources and the time households spend collecting water, hand washing, improved and unimproved sanitation, rubbish disposal, the main source of lighting and cooking energy, and communication appliances and internet connections. The report says that 81.1 percent of households lit their homes with solar power, while in Honiara 62.3 percent used the main electricity grid. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF download, no registration; PopGIS shows census maps and tables. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: tables are PDF layout and must be transcribed, and the www host name failed TLS name checks while the bare domain works. Simulation uses: solar versus grid lighting by province for electrification planning, and building materials and water collection burden for cyclone and drought exposure. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts with electricity access.
